reconciliation: No source change was made. The current narrative already has the requested boundary section, directs CoverageEligibilityResponse use for eligibility/benefit/preauthorization responses, distinguishes neighboring financial resources, and says CoverageEligibilityRequest requests a CoverageEligibilityResponse. Adding a literal "only response" sentence would be redundant and could overstate the historical wording and current optional request-reference model.
